items.title: MariaDB 13 Expands Oracle Compatibility and Improves Developer Experience and Observability
items.summaryShort: MariaDB 13 Expands Oracle Compatibility and Improves Developer Experience and Observability. MariaDB Community Server 13.0 has reached General Availability (GA) and is now officially stable.

items.title: DoorDash Uses Multi Agent LLMs to Clean up 60,000 Feature Flags
items.summaryShort: DoorDash Uses Multi Agent LLMs to Clean up 60,000 Feature Flags. DoorDash built a multi-agent LLM system to automate stale feature flag cleanup across more than 60,000 flags and 623 repositories.

items.title: Presentation: Complexity and Creativity in Software Engineering
items.summaryShort: Presentation: Complexity and Creativity in Software Engineering. Phillip Mortimer discusses the shift toward write-only software driven by AI code generation.

items.title: htmx 4.0: a Fetch-Based Rewrite, Built-In Morphing Swaps, and Explicit Attribute Inheritance
items.summaryShort: htmx 4.0: a Fetch-Based Rewrite, Built-In Morphing Swaps, and Explicit Attribute Inheritance. htmx 4 has been released, featuring a transition from XMLHttpRequest to the fetch() API, enhancing streaming capabilities.

items.title: India forces caller-ID apps to feed spam reports to telcos
items.summaryShort: India forces caller-ID apps to feed spam reports to telcos. Truecaller says the one-way sharing requirement would hand a commercially valuable proprietary asset to telecom operators.

items.summaryShort: A startup that builds other startups raised $100M and is all-in on physical AI. UP.Labs, now doing business under the name Vantora, is building startups for industrial corporations.
